About.premier_vet_alliance: Premier Vet Alliance is a leading veterinary group with over a decade of experience delivering premium care to veterinary and animal health customers, partnering with more than 3,000 practices worldwide.
About.we_provide_technology: We provide technology, training, financial support, marketing, and business intelligence to create tailored preventative pet health plans, supporting business growth and enhancing pet health and wellbeing globally.
About.founded_in_2007: Founded in 2007 in Bristol, UK, we began as a small veterinary group aiming to transform the industry through technology, innovation, and premium care.
About.while_initially_focused: While initially focused on the UK, we have since expanded to the USA, Ireland, Netherlands, Germany, and France.
About.our_market_leading_health: Our market leading health offer a simple, affordable, and user-friendly solution to premium preventative health care.
About.our_vision_remains: Today, our vision remains the same. With a growing range of products and services, we enhance clinical compliance, customer loyalty, and deliver top-tier pet care to support your business growth. Our flexible solutions foster lasting partnerships, equipping you to excel in veterinary care.
About.our_industry_experience: Our industry experience—from practices to manufacturers—enables us to understand your business needs and improve efficiency. As one of the few health plan providers with hands-on management experience, we offer unique insights and tailored support.
About.building_a_legacy_of: Building a Legacy of Veterinary Excellence Worldwide
About.from_small_uk_veterinary: From a small UK veterinary group to a global partner, we’ve continuously evolved to support practices and pet owners with innovation and care.
About.pva_began_as_small_group: PVA began as a small group focused on transforming veterinary care through innovation and strong partnerships.
